# Accessibility Evaluation Report: RiverCity Metro (Q3 2026)

## Evaluation Identity
- **Evaluator:** Meridian Digital Accessibility
- **Commissioner:** RiverCity Metro Authority, Office of Civil Rights
- **Evaluation Window:** 2026-06-22 → 2026-07-24
- **Methodology:** WCAG-EM 2.0 (https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em-2/)

## Scope
**In-scope:** All member-facing content on rivercitymetro.org (trip planner, schedules, fares, service alerts, pass-holder account area), the RideRC native app’s ticket-activation flow, and monthly PDF timetables.  
**Out-of-scope / Named Exclusions:** Third-party real-time vehicle map iframe (vendor-supplied; documented, not remediable this cycle).

## Conformance Target
WCAG 2.2 Level AA

## Accessibility Support Baseline
Evaluated combinations (as run): NVDA 2026.1 + Firefox 141 (Windows 11); VoiceOver + Safari 18 (macOS 15); TalkBack 15 + Chrome (Android 15); keyboard-only without a screen reader.

## Additional Requirements
- Findings to be filed per the bug-reporting template.
- Plain-language summary provided for the transit board.

## Technologies Relied Upon
HTML, CSS, JavaScript (React), WAI-ARIA (web surfaces).  
*Note:* RideRC app is native Kotlin/Swift and evaluated separately from web technologies.

## Sample Set
**Structured samples (10):** S01–S10 representing landing template, SPA form/results, timetable-table, live alert list, fare content/template, authenticated dashboard, payment flow, long-form/contact/application, article, and static policy templates.  
**Random samples (1):** R01 = /riders/lost-and-found (10% of structured set). Selection method: seeded shuffle of the 214-URL sitemap (seed 7391), first non-duplicate URL selected. Representativeness check surfaced a legacy template class; S11 (/riders/title-vi) was added and evaluated. A second comparison confirmed no new content types or finding types.  
**Complete processes:** P01 (web: plan trip → buy monthly pass → confirmation, default + declined-payment error branch); P02 (native app: activate ticket → present QR, default sequence).  
**State coverage:** Default, loading, error, and expanded states per sample where the template includes them.

## Outcomes
Per-SC outcomes across the sample set using EARL vocabulary. At least one example is provided for each SC not met. Severity judgments are orthogonal to these conformance outcomes and reside in the findings section.

| SC | Outcome | Example / Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1.1 Non-text Content | `passed` | Image alt groups passed across all 12 scanned views. |
| 1.3.1 Info and Relationships | `failed` | Two sampled monthly PDF timetables lack structural tags and programmatic reading order. |
| 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) | `failed` | Route-badge text measured at 2.8:1; article byline at 3.9:1 (both below 4.5:1). |
| 2.1.1 Keyboard | `failed` | Fare-zone selector on S07 is drag-only; focusable but value cannot be changed via keyboard, blocking purchase completion. |
| 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks | `failed` | Skip-link anchor target ID absent on the legacy info-page template (R01/S11). |
| 2.4.2 Page Titled | `passed` | Document title rule passed on all 12 views. |
| 2.4.3 Focus Order | `passed` | Focus order followed visual order throughout P01 default and error branches. |
| 2.4.7 Focus Visible | `passed` | Focus-indicator sufficiency passed on every interactive element measured across 12 views. |
| 3.1.1 Language of Page | `passed` | `html-has-lang` / `html-lang-valid` passed on all 12 views. |
| 3.1.2 Language of Parts | `untested` | No multi-lingual content or language-switching functionality exists in sampled views. |
| 3.3.1 Error Identification | `failed` | Declined-payment message renders visually but is not announced nor programmatically associated with the card field. |
| 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value | `failed` | Icon-only swap button lacks accessible name; native ticket-activate control exposes no label to TalkBack/VoiceOver. |
| 4.1.3 Status Messages | `failed` | Purchase confirmation renders visually but contains no live region; silent in driven session. |
| 1.2.x (Audio/Video) | `inapplicable` | No audio or video content exists in any sampled view. |

**Representativeness check result:** Random sampling expanded the structured set to cover a legacy template class absent from the initial plan. A second comparison confirmed no new content types or finding categories, validating sample adequacy.

## Findings
The following findings back the outcomes above. Severity reflects user impact and is orthogonal to conformance outcomes; it must not be derived from rule weight or collapsed into severity rankings.

- `a11y_fare_zone_slider_keyboard` (CRITICAL)
- `a11y_swap_button_name` (MINOR)
- `a11y_route_badge_contrast` (MAJOR)
- `a11y_payment_error_association` (MAJOR)
- `a11y_legacy_skiplink_anchor` (MINOR)
- `a11y_purchase_confirm_silent` (MAJOR)
- `a11y_ticket_activate_unlabeled` (MAJOR)
- `a11y_timetable_pdf_untagged` (MAJOR)

## Coverage Boundary
The web measurement stack (axe-core, Playwright/CDP) could not measure the RideRC native app ticket-activation flow (P02) or the monthly PDF timetables. These were covered via manual AT sessions (TalkBack and VoiceOver on 2026-07-15 for P02) and manual document inspection (2026-07-16 for PDFs). All other evaluated samples were fully measurable by the web stack.

## Evaluation Statement
This engagement reports **partial conformance** to WCAG 2.2 Level AA. The portal does not meet the target level due to non-conformances in keyboard operability (2.1.1), error identification (3.3.1), status messages (4.1.3), contrast (1.4.3), bypass blocks (2.4.1), name/role/value (4.1.2), and info/relationships for documents (1.3.1). Sampling-based evaluation alone does not support a WCAG 2 conformance claim for the whole product; this statement applies strictly to the evaluated samples, processes, and assets documented in the outcomes and findings sections.

## Aggregated Score
Not applied per WCAG-EM guidance against score aggregation.

## Machine Readable
EARL export not produced for this engagement.
